_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: The name of the experiment. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing all files needed to execute the simulation in the <ROOT_DIR>/simulations/<experiment> directory. The folder will also contain all generated simulation statistics/outputs.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. Must be built from the td-load-rrip-min-extrapolate branch (adds td_load_rrip_min_rrpv / td_load_rrip_extrapolate / td_load_rrip_extrap_anchor and the signed-RRPV marked-RRIP hit handler).
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'. Must match td_load_record so the recorded PC marked set covers these simpoints.
_simulations: Marked-line RRIP replacement sweep over the NEW initial-RRPV knobs. Requires a prior td_load_record (PC) run that populated --td_load_dir with <trace>_mem_bound_loads_pc.csv. All marked configs hold --td_load_replay_key pc --td_load_replay_thresh 0.5 fixed so the ONLY variable is how a marked (membound) line's initial RRPV is chosen: (a) fixed minimum via --td_load_rrip_min_rrpv (may be negative -> stronger-than-RRPV-0 protection), or (b) --td_load_rrip_extrapolate 1 to linearly map the load's membound fraction to an RRPV in [min, RRIP_DISTANT_VAL-1], with --td_load_rrip_extrap_anchor selecting the ramp's low fraction anchor (negative => defaults to the mark threshold). min=0 + extrapolate off reproduces the pre-change marked=RRPV-0 point. Compare IPC vs. baseline with plot_td_load_ipc.py.
_configurations: baseline = untouched machine (default DCACHE_REPL). All rrip_* configs are marked-RRIP at threshold 0.5 (key=pc) and differ only in the initial-RRPV scheme. rrip_min0 = the pre-change RRPV-0 behavior (back-compat reference). rrip_min_neg1 / rrip_min_neg4 = fixed negative minimum (extrapolation off). rrip_extrap_neg4 = fraction-extrapolated ramp to min=-4 with the low anchor defaulting to the threshold. rrip_extrap_neg4_anchor0 = same ramp but anchored at fraction 0.0 (protection starts as soon as a load crosses the threshold). Requires td_load_record (pc) to have run first with the same --td_load_dir.

rrip_extrap_neg64_anchor50._params: Extrapolate the membound fraction to an initial RRPV in [-4, 1] with the ramp anchored at fraction 0.0, so a load gets meaningful protection as soon as it crosses the threshold.

rrip_extrap_neg64_anchor30._params: Extrapolate the membound fraction to an initial RRPV in [-4, 1] with the ramp anchored at fraction 0.0, so a load gets meaningful protection as soon as it crosses the threshold.

rrip_extrap_neg64_anchor10._params: Extrapolate the membound fraction to an initial RRPV in [-4, 1] with the ramp anchored at fraction 0.0, so a load gets meaningful protection as soon as it crosses the threshold.

rrip_extrap_neg64_anchor01._params: Extrapolate the membound fraction to an initial RRPV in [-4, 1] with the ramp anchored at fraction 0.0, so a load gets meaningful protection as soon as it crosses the threshold.

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_visualize: Visualization settings for ./sci --visualize. Configure baseline and counters.
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
